req.title: Update existing post
req.statement: The system shall update the row when POST /<id>/update is called by the post's author with a title and body, and redirect to /.

doc.reasoning: The requirement covers POST /<id>/update by the post's author with valid title+body → DB row updated + 302 redirect to /. Key mutation targets: status code 302 (not 200/301), redirect location '/' (not '/update'), DB persistence of new title/body, author-only enforcement (403 for non-author), and missing-title validation (flash error, no redirect). Tests cover: (1) positive EP – author updates own post, checks redirect and DB; (2) negative NEG – non-author gets 403; (3) negative NEG – missing title returns error, no redirect; (4) STC – state transition: post exists → updated in DB; (5) BVA – title of exactly 1 character (minimum non-empty boundary).

tests.name: test_update_post_by_author_redirects_and_persists
preconditions: Database contains post id=2 authored by user id=1 (Rahul)
actions: POST /2/update with title='Updated Title' and body='Updated body text'
expected: Database row for post id=2 has title='Updated Title' and body='Updated body text'
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app
from flaskr.db import get_db

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    from flaskr.db import init_db
    init_db()

client = app.test_client()
with client.session_transaction() as sess:
    pass

r_login = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'})
assert r_login.status_code == 302

r = client.post('/2/update', data={'title': 'Updated Title', 'body': 'Updated body text'})
assert r.status_code == 302
assert r.headers['Location'] == '/'

with app.app_context():
    db = get_db()
    row = db.execute('SELECT title, body FROM post WHERE id = 2').fetchone()
    assert row['title'] == 'Updated Title'
    assert row['body'] == 'Updated body text'

os.unlink(path)

tests.name: test_update_post_state_transition_old_to_new_values
preconditions: Database contains post id=10 authored by user id=1 (Rahul)
Post id=10 has title='Elux matrix prism' before update
actions: POST /10/update with title='New State Title' and body='New State Body'
Verify DB state transitioned from old values to new values
expected: Post id=10 title is now 'New State Title' (not 'Elux matrix prism')
Post id=10 body is now 'New State Body'
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app
from flaskr.db import get_db

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    from flaskr.db import init_db
    init_db()

client = app.test_client()

with app.app_context():
    db = get_db()
    before = db.execute('SELECT title, body FROM post WHERE id = 10').fetchone()
    assert before['title'] == 'Elux matrix prism'

r_login = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'})
assert r_login.status_code == 302

r = client.post('/10/update', data={'title': 'New State Title', 'body': 'New State Body'})
assert r.status_code == 302
assert r.headers['Location'] == '/'

with app.app_context():
    db = get_db()
    after = db.execute('SELECT title, body FROM post WHERE id = 10').fetchone()
    assert after['title'] == 'New State Title'
    assert after['body'] == 'New State Body'
    assert after['title'] != 'Elux matrix prism'

os.unlink(path)

from flaskr.db import get_db
